    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    while t > 0:
        n = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        sets = []
        element_to_sets = defaultdict(list)
        for _ in range(n):
            k = int(input[index])
            index += 1
            current_set = set(map(int, input[index:index+k]))
            sets.append(current_set)
            for element in current_set:
                element_to_sets[element].append(len(sets) - 1)
            index += k
        found = False
        for element, set_indices in element_to_sets.items():
            if len(set_indices) > 1:
                for i in range(len(set_indices)):
                    for j in range(i + 1, len(set_indices)):
                        if len(sets[set_indices[i]].intersection(sets[set_indices[j]])) >= 2:
                            results.append(f"{set_indices[i] + 1} {set_indices[j] + 1}")
                            found = True
                            break
                    if found:
                        break
            if found:
                break
        if not found:
            results.append("-1")
        t -= 1
    print("\n".join(results))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
